items.name: Winthrop Beach (DCR Winthrop Shore Reservation)
items.managedBy: Massachusetts DCR (Department of Conservation and Recreation)
items.summary: The town's main ocean beach: about a mile of sand and pebble shore along Winthrop Shore Drive, state-owned since 1900, open dawn to dusk with restrooms, a beach wheelchair, and the five offshore breakwaters locals call the Five Sisters.
items.parking: Free parking along the beach (DCR); MBTA Blue Line to Orient Heights then bus 712/713.
items.seasonal: DCR: no dogs on the beach April 1 to Sept. 15. Wikipedia: lifeguards on duty late June to early September.

items.name: Short Beach (DCR Winthrop Shore Reservation)
items.managedBy: Massachusetts DCR (Department of Conservation and Recreation)
items.address: Revere Street at the Winthrop/Revere line, Winthrop, MA 02152
items.summary: A sandy DCR beach on the isthmus between Winthrop and Revere, listed by the town as part of the Winthrop Shore Reservation.

items.name: Yirrell Beach
items.summary: The town-managed ocean beach on Shirley Street in Point Shirley, about 3,660 feet of sand behind a concrete seawall with a walkway and benches, an ADA ramp at the north end, and a buoyed swim area the Harbormaster enforces.
items.parking: Street parking (CZM). Town-wide: a resident permit is required on all town streets and municipal lots 1-5 AM; a 2020 resident-only pilot covered the Point Shirley streets south of the beach.
items.seasonal: Town plan: raking and lifeguard stands during the swimming season, typically before Memorial Day through the end of August; shorebird nesting closures April 1 to August 31. Wikipedia: Sandcastle Festival in June.

items.name: Point Shirley Beach
items.address: Shirley Street south of Yirrell Beach, Point Shirley, Winthrop, MA 02152
items.summary: The sandy southern continuation of Yirrell Beach along Point Shirley, a separate 5-acre town parcel reached from the Yirrell Beach walkway.
items.note: Parcel runs lat 42.3565-42.3615; the point given is on the parcel inside the bbox, north of its centroid (42.35895,-70.96952).

items.name: Donovan's Beach
items.address: Pleasant Street at Brookfield Road, Winthrop, MA 02152
items.summary: A small town-owned sand-and-pebble beach on the harbor side at Pleasant Street and Brookfield Road, one of the quieter neighborhood beaches.

items.name: Pico Beach
items.address: End of Pico Avenue, Winthrop, MA 02152
items.summary: A pebble beach on the harbor side at the foot of Pico Avenue, backed by Pico Park's benches, playground and tennis courts.

items.name: Halford Beach
items.address: Corner of Nahant and Sewall, Winthrop, MA 02152
items.summary: A rocky neighborhood beach on the ocean side at the corner of Nahant and Sewall, north of Winthrop Beach.

items.name: Grandview Beach
items.address: Grandview Avenue, Point Shirley, Winthrop, MA 02152
items.summary: A public bathing beach on the harbor side of Point Shirley along Grandview Avenue, tracked by the state's marine-beach water-quality program.
items.parking: Not stated by any source; the surrounding Point Shirley streets fall under the town's resident-permit rules.

items.name: Woodside Park beach
items.address: End of Woodside, Cottage Park, Winthrop, MA 02152
items.summary: A small sand-and-pebble beach at the foot of Woodside in the Cottage Park neighborhood, on the harbor side.

items.name: Coughlin Park shore
items.address: End of Bay View Avenue, Point Shirley, Winthrop, MA 02152
items.summary: A 10-acre town park on the harbor side of Point Shirley under the Logan flight path, with benches, picnic tables, playground and sports fields and a shoreline the town has studied for bank restoration.
items.parking: Free parking at the end of Bay View Avenue (CZM); the angle parking beside the park was exempt from the 2020 resident pilot except for the town-wide 1-5 AM permit rule.

items.name: Lewis Lake Park
items.summary: A 14-acre town park around Lewis Lake, a tidal pond and river behind Winthrop Beach, with benches and a playground.

items.name: Winthrop Public Landing (town boat ramp)
items.managedBy: Town of Winthrop (a state/DCR boat-launch facility managed by the town)
items.address: Winthrop Boat Ramp, Shirley Street, Winthrop, MA 02152
items.summary: The public boat ramp and town pier on the harbor, with benches and shore access, run by the Harbormaster.
items.parking: Parking lot: $10 recreational / $100 commercial ramp fee for trailers (not a parking fee); cars without trailers park on the perimeter; DCR 18-hour limit; $10 visitor pass for Veterans Road.

items.name: Deer Island trail shore
items.managedBy: MWRA (Massachusetts Water Resources Authority); within the Boston Harbor Islands National Park Area
items.summary: Five miles of public walkways around the treatment-plant peninsula south of Point Shirley, including a 2.6-mile paved accessible perimeter path, a fishing pier and ten overlooks, open sunrise to sunset year-round.
items.parking: Free parking at the head of the island by the entrance; MWRA asks visitors not to park in the Winthrop neighborhoods.
items.seasonal: Open year-round sunrise to sunset (MWRA). Dogs on leash; no alcohol, camping, open flames or motorized vehicles.
items.note: The public parking lot is at lat 42.3557, just south of the requested bbox (42.36); nothing on Deer Island's public access lies north of 42.36. Coordinates are real, not clipped.
